component.name: ScreenSync
component.summary: Healthy Device Usage & Cross-Device Reel Tracker

description.p: ScreenSync tracks cross-device screen time, short-form video sessions (Reels, Shorts, TikTok, Stories), mindful break reminders, and focus goals across Linux, Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, and Web.

Pass 26 (v3.4.0 Build 34): Added Brain State Visual dedicated Account sub-page, live animated per-reel & 50-reel degrading brain icon in Dynamic Island, and every-50-reels full-display milestone overlay with automatic Dynamic Island hide/restore and 4-mode responsive optimization.
